sources.name: Administrative boundaries
sources.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
sources.limits: Pre-2022 reorganisation: 18 towns + 6 cantonments. Boundaries are simplified.

sources.name: NASA MODIS/Aqua MYD11A2 v6.1 — LST & Emissivity 8-Day 1 km
sources.provider: ORNL DAAC MODIS Global Subsets web service
sources.detail: Hot-season (1 May–30 Jun) composites 2024–2026; Aqua overpass ≈ 13:30 (day) and ≈ 01:30 (night) local time; quality-flagged pixels removed.
sources.limits: 8-day clear-sky composites at 1 km; cloudy pixels excluded; surface (skin) temperature, not air temperature.

sources.name: NASA MODIS/Terra MOD13Q1 v6.1 — NDVI 16-Day 250 m
sources.provider: ORNL DAAC MODIS Global Subsets web service
sources.detail: Same hot-season windows 2024–2026; water pixels (NDVI < 0) excluded from means.
sources.limits: 250 m vegetation greenness; arid-zone values are low everywhere, so compare units relatively.

sources.name: Global 2000-2020 1km UN-adjusted — Pakistan 2020
sources.limits: Modelled 2020 estimate on a ~1 km grid, not a census count.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap features (health facilities and green space)
sources.limits: Mapped features only; OSM coverage is uneven. Green area counts closed OSM polygons assigned to the unit containing their centre point; open multipolygon rings are skipped (a mild under-count).

sources.name: ERA5-Land reanalysis — daily air temperature
sources.provider: ECMWF ERA5-Land reanalysis via Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
sources.limits: ~9 km grid (model reanalysis, not station data)
